During the [[Clone Wars]], [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] undertook a '''mission''' to the [[planet]] [[Scipio]] to take out a loan, but in truth, sought to uncover evidence of corruption within the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan]]. Amidala and her old flame, [[Baron]] [[Rush Clovis]], became targeted by the [[bounty hunter]] [[Embo]], who was hired by the [[Sith Lord]] [[Darth Sidious]]. Unbeknownst to them, Embo wasn't tasked with killing anyone, but to intimidate and drive Clovis off-world, as part of Sidious' plans for the Banking Clan.<ref name="AOF" />
